findings.description: Nicola Domenichelli died on 29 June 1981; his death was registered the next day in the civil register of Rosario de la Frontera, Salta, Argentina, which records him as a widower born about 1897.

details.place: Rosario de la Frontera, Salta, Argentina

supporting_sources: Argentina, Salta, Civil Registration, 1880-2000 — death entry for Nicolas Domenichelli, registered 30 Jun 1981
